rules.name: recon-dup-05-whole-table-duplicates
rules.sql: WITH g AS ( SELECT 'settle' AS table_name, s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT s.trade_id) AS dt, count(DISTINCT md5(concat_ws('|', s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.portfolio, s.value_date, s.parent_trade_id, s.derivative_type, s.instrument_class))) AS dw FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id UNION ALL SELECT 'actual', s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, count(*), count(DISTINCT s.trade_id), count(DISTINCT md5(concat_ws('|', s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.portfolio, s.value_date, s.parent_trade_id, s.derivative_type, s.instrument_class))) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id ), gp AS ( SELECT g.*, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = g.business_unit AND p.view_type = CASE g.table_name WHEN 'settle' THEN 'SETTLE_PRICING' ELSE 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' END AND p.settlement_date = g.settlement_date AND p.published_run_id = g.run_id) AS pub FROM g ) SELECT table_name, sum(n) AS total_rows, count(*) AS runs, count(DISTINCT business_unit || '|' || settlement_date) AS bu_dates, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n > dw) AS runs_with_dups, sum(n - dw) AS extra_rows_wide_key, sum(n - dt) AS extra_rows_trade_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT pub) AS unpublished_runs, COALESCE(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE NOT pub), 0) AS rows_unpublished FROM gp GROUP BY table_name ORDER BY table_name

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'settle' AS table_name, s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, count(*) AS n, count(*) - count(DISTINCT md5(concat_ws('|', s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.portfolio, s.value_date, s.parent_trade_id, s.derivative_type, s.instrument_class))) AS extra_rows, min(s.created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(s.created_timestamp) AS last_created FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id UNION ALL SELECT 'actual', s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, count(*), count(*) - count(DISTINCT md5(concat_ws('|', s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.portfolio, s.value_date, s.parent_trade_id, s.derivative_type, s.instrument_class))), min(s.created_timestamp), max(s.created_timestamp) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id ) x WHERE x.extra_rows > 0 ORDER BY x.extra_rows DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'settle' AS table_name, s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT s.created_timestamp) AS n_created_timestamps, min(s.created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(s.created_timestamp) AS last_created, string_agg(DISTINCT s.created_by, ',') AS created_by_users FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date HAVING count(*) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'actual', s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date, count(*), count(DISTINCT s.created_timestamp), min(s.created_timestamp), max(s.created_timestamp), string_agg(DISTINCT s.created_by, ',') FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date HAVING count(*) > 1 ) x ORDER BY x.n_rows DESC, x.business_unit, x.trade_id LIMIT 30

SELECT g.table_name, g.business_unit, g.settlement_date, g.run_id, g.n AS rows_held, r.status, r.row_count AS run_row_count, r.requested_by, r.requested_at FROM ( SELECT 'settle' AS table_name, 'SETTLE_PRICING' AS view_type, s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, count(*) AS n FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id UNION ALL SELECT 'actual', 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING', s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, count(*) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id ) g LEFT JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = g.run_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = g.business_unit AND p.view_type = g.view_type AND p.settlement_date = g.settlement_date AND p.published_run_id = g.run_id) ORDER BY g.n DESC LIMIT 50

expect.reason: one row for each snapshot table
every run that still holds rows is published
